name: Avatar
description: User identity display with image and fallback initials

name.description: Person's full name, used for initials and the accessible name.

fallback.description: Text or rich content shown instead of initials while the image is unavailable.

fallbackDelayMs.description: Delay for a pending image. Missing/failed images show fallback immediately.

aria.nativeElement: A span with role=img and the complete person name; the inner native image has empty alt to avoid duplicate announcements.
notes: The name prop labels both loaded and fallback states. Override with aria-label or aria-labelledby, or use aria-hidden for a decorative avatar beside a visible name.
fallback accepts text or React content; omitted fallback derives initials from name.
Avatar uses shared control geometry for compact identity chips.
Fallback initials are generated by the avatar machine; custom fallback content should remain icon/text sized to the same control box.
